title: The Rajputs
definition: A group of warrior clans emerging in North and Western India (c. 7th–12th century) claiming Kshatriya status, characterized by a feudal political structure, chivalric code, and intense regionalism.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for understanding the political fragmentation of India before the Ghurid invasions and the transition from the Gupta-post-Gupta era to the Sultanate period.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of The Rajputs.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
